doc.name: AISeeWhy AI crawler & AEO audit
doc.instructions: AISeeWhy audits whether AI crawlers and AI search can read and cite a web page. Each finding has a priority (P1 critical, P2 important, P3 nice to have or a policy choice), evidence and ready-to-paste fixes (robots.txt diff, Cloudflare rule, JSON-LD, llms.txt). Each page report also has a classic SEO block (title, description, H1, canonical, noindex, links) with its own score, and crawl_site audits a whole site for SEO and find_broken_links finds broken links level by level. Blocks are tested from an unverified IP. Support: support@aiseewhy.com.

annotations.title: Audit a URL for AI crawlers

tools.description: Audit one URL: fetch it as 16 AI and search crawlers plus curl and a browser, check robots.txt, structured data, answer-first content, freshness, hreflang and llms.txt, plus classic on-page SEO (title, meta description, H1, canonical, noindex, image alt text, broken links). Returns a Markdown report with findings and fixes. language: report language code (en, de, ja, …).

url.description: Page to audit: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com (https is assumed).
url.title: Url

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 30 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

bots.description: Only test these crawlers, by name (for example GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended). Omit to test all 16 AI and search crawlers.
bots.title: Bots

tools.name: audit_url

tools.description: Audit up to 10 pages listed in a sitemap or sitemap index. Returns one summary line per page plus the full report of every page with findings. Needs an API key.

sitemap_url.description: URL of a sitemap.xml or sitemap index, for example https://example.com/sitemap.xml.
sitemap_url.title: Sitemap Url

max_urls.description: How many page URLs from the sitemap to audit, 1 to 10.
max_urls.title: Max Urls

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 30 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: audit_sitemap

tools.description: Explain a finding id (e.g. access.blocked, robots.disallowed, schema.software_no_offers) in the given language: what it means, why it matters for AI search and how to fix it.

finding_id.description: Finding id exactly as shown in an audit report, for example access.blocked or llms.missing.
finding_id.title: Finding Id

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 30 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: explain_finding

tools.description: Audit 2 or 3 URLs (yours and competitors') and compare them side by side: score, P1/P2/P3 counts, blocked crawlers, llms.txt, structured data, text without JavaScript. Needs an API key.

urls.description: 2 or 3 page URLs or domains to compare; put your own page first.
urls.title: Urls

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 30 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: compare_urls

tools.description: SEO site audit: crawl up to 50 pages (up to 90 seconds) of a site from a start page by following internal links (then the sitemap), as a browser and respecting robots.txt. Reports broken and redirected internal links, duplicate titles and descriptions, orphan, deep and thin pages, sitemap entries that are noindex, redirect or name another canonical, and on-page SEO problems counted across pages. Needs an API key.

url.description: Start page of the crawl, usually the home page: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com. Only pages on the same host are crawled.
url.title: Url

max_pages.description: How many pages to crawl, 1 to 50.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 30 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

tools.name: crawl_site

tools.description: Broken link finder: read a page and the pages of the same site it links to, level by level (depth 0 is the start page only; up to 50 pages and 90 seconds), and check every link found once: pages, other sites and images. Returns the broken links with the link text and the pages that contain them, apart from links that could not be verified (blocked, rate limited, slow) and redirects. Respects robots.txt for pages it walks into. Needs an API key.

url.description: Start page: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com. Only pages on the same host are walked; links to other sites are checked but not followed.
url.title: Url

depth.description: Levels of pages to follow from the start page, 0 to 3.
depth.title: Depth

max_pages.description: How many pages to read, 1 to 50.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

tools.name: find_broken_links

tools.description: Add a URL to the account's scheduled monitoring (freq: daily or weekly). The owner gets an email when a check finds a new P1 problem or the score drops by 10 or more. Needs an API key; adding the same URL again only changes the frequency.

url.description: Page to monitor: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com.
url.title: Url

freq.description: How often to check the page: daily or weekly (default).
freq.title: Freq

tools.name: watch_site

tools.description: List the URLs this account monitors, with the frequency, last score and last check time. Needs an API key.
tools.name: list_watched_sites
